sessions.title: FOO-201 Checkout button misaligned on Safari
FOO-77 Intermittent 502
sessions.outcome: The watcher's agent exited with an error

content.text: The socket doesn't reconnect after the laptop sleeps. Please fix it.
The reconnect timer is cleared on close, so a sleep that drops the socket never schedules a retry.
I'll look at how the socket schedules its retries.
The retry is only scheduled from `onclose`; I'll also schedule it when the ping goes unanswered.
The board takes two seconds to paint on a cold start. Can you cache the first page?
I'll keep the last page of tickets on disk and paint it before the socket connects.
Done: the board now paints from the cache, then refreshes when the socket connects.
